_readme: Single source of truth for the whole Howdy deployment.
Edit this file, re-run deploy.sh, and the app picks up the changes.
You can add a module or a trusted source domain here WITHOUT touching Python.
Secrets never live here — they are generated into /etc/howdy/secrets/ by deploy.sh.

app.name: Howdy
app.tagline: Your companion for life in Australia
app.description: Verified-source guidance for international students and new migrants in Australia. Guidance, not legal advice.

hosting._comment: Sizing hints for deploy.sh. Cheapest first.

free.target: Oracle Cloud Always Free — ARM Ampere
free.note: Free tier was halved to 2 OCPU / 12 GB in June 2026. Stay at or under or the instance gets terminated.

beta.note: Paid, small, reliable. Right for a public beta.

launch.note: Australian data residency. Required by most university procurement.

_alternatives.claude-haiku-4-5: ~60% cheaper. Worth a blind quality test before launch.
_alternatives.claude-opus-4-8: Higher ceiling, ~2x cost. Overkill for knowledge-base-grounded answers.

web_search._note: Live search for volatile facts (wage rates, fees, dates). HARD-RESTRICTED to the same trusted domains as citation verification — Claude physically cannot search anything else.
search_when: the answer depends on a current dollar figure, rate, fee or threshold
the answer depends on a date, deadline or 'as of' year
the user asks what the rule is 'now' or 'currently'
the knowledge base has no entry for the topic
web_search._cost_note: Each search adds cost. max_uses_per_answer caps it. Set enabled=false to run knowledge-base-only.

privacy._note: 0 retention days means 'keep until the user deletes it'. Guest and incognito write nothing at all.

sources._note: Kip may ONLY cite these. Verified server-side after every reply; anything else is stripped.

housing_search._note: Kip never invents listings. It builds live search URLs on these platforms.

legal.disclaimer: Kip provides general information sourced from official Australian government websites. It is not legal, migration, tax or financial advice, and is not a substitute for a registered professional.
legal._critical: Under the Migration Act 1958, giving immigration assistance without registration is a criminal offence. Kip must only ever give GENERAL information and refer individual matters to a MARA-registered agent. Have a registered agent review app/prompt.py and knowledge/base.json before launch.
